title: Number bonds to 5 and 10
examples: Teacher, can we use our fingers to show number bonds?
What is the missing number if I have 7 and 3?
Can you show me how the ten frame helps with ten?

explain.say: Today we will learn number bonds to five and ten. We will learn about the part-part-whole relationship. This means we look at the parts that make up a whole number.
Let us look at the number five. If we know two parts, we can find the whole. For example, two and three make a whole of five.
We can use a ten frame to help us see number bonds to ten. The ten frame has ten spaces for dots. We fill the spaces to make a whole of ten.
Sometimes we need to find a missing part. If we know the whole and one part, we can find the other part. For example, if the whole is ten and one part is four, the missing part is six.

faq.a: A number bond shows how smaller numbers fit together to make a bigger number. It shows the parts that make up the whole.
asks: How do I know what the whole number is?

faq.q: How do I use the ten frame?
faq.a: The ten frame helps us count up to ten using ten spaces. We fill the spaces to see how many are left to make ten.
asks: What is the ten frame for?
Can I use dots on the ten frame?

faq.q: If I know 10 and 3, how do I find the missing part?
faq.a: You take the whole number, which is ten, and take away the part you know, which is three. Ten minus three equals seven.

faq.q: Do I always use the ten frame for number bonds?
faq.a: No, you can use fingers or draw circles for smaller numbers. The ten frame is very helpful when we get to ten.
asks: Is the ten frame only for ten?
Can I use it for five?

faq.q: What is the difference between a part and a whole?
faq.a: The parts are the smaller numbers you start with. The whole is the total number you get when you put the parts together.
asks: Are the parts always smaller than the whole?

facts: Number bonds show how parts combine to make a whole.
The ten frame helps visualize numbers up to ten.
If you know the whole and one part, you can find the missing part.
Five is the whole for two and three.

quiz.say: What is the whole number for 4 and 1?
quiz.why: You count the parts together: four fingers and one more finger makes five.

wrong.0: Adding the numbers twice is a common error.
wrong.2: Subtracting instead of adding is a common mistake.
wrong.3: Only using one of the numbers is incorrect.

quiz.say: If the whole is 10 and one part is 7, what is the missing part?
quiz.why: You count up from seven on the ten frame until you reach ten. You need three more.

wrong.1: Adding the numbers together is not how you find the missing part.
wrong.2: This is the number you subtracted instead of finding the difference.
wrong.3: This is just repeating one of the numbers given.

quiz.say: Show two ways to make the number five.
quiz.why: You can combine two small groups to make five. Two and three is one way.

wrong.0: This only makes two, not the whole number five.
wrong.1: This makes ten, which is too big for the whole number five.
wrong.3: While mathematically true, we usually look for two non-zero parts.
